name: smwmusic-lemons-mid
title: LEMONS.MID
description:
One of the midi files that comes with Multimedia Fusion/Clickteam Fusion and heard in games like Noseman. Ported by hand. Includes an alternative version that loops seamlessly with no silence.

Weird cellos are used to replicate midi cuica. They're on their own channel and labelled, so they're easy to mute if desired.
